name: indahl
description: Every Heuremen LLC plugin in one install: check papers and LLM eval claims against the Standards, query and reproduce every indahl.ai desk, check and correct IBM Quantum runs, test whether a plan was pushed before the first run, and check readings for a complete check block. Includes the indahl.ai data connector. Scripts are fetched from the public indahl.ai repository at pinned sha256; the version with bundled scripts and the automatic readcheck commit gate is indahl-full in the Heuremen-LLC/indahl.ai marketplace.
